Training Planner

Choose how many times to train in each sport and mark your day constraints.

  1. Every valid seven-day week is generated, including plans with tighter spacing.
  2. Weeks are ordered by the fewest adjacent training-day pairs, then by the most even gaps between sessions.
  3. Sunday and Monday count as neighbours. Forbidden days count toward elapsed time between sessions.

Adjacent means training on two consecutive days. Nothing is filtered out.
